product.olivetti-m6-450.summary: The 50 MHz DX2 configuration in the first M6 family covered by the guide.
product.olivetti-m6-450.history: In April 1994, MCmicrocomputer placed the M6-4xx in Olivetti’s professional workstation range. The M6-450 was the lower of the two DX2 configurations in the series.
product.olivetti-m6-450.architecture: Memory could grow without replacing the board. The guide records 4 MB soldered and three sequential SIMM sockets. The documented board is BA2003 / BA2004.
product.olivetti-m6-450.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash EPROM · Rev. 1.20.
product.olivetti-m6-450.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m6-450.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-450.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, §37, pp. 37-1–37-3.
